title: reader::ClientCertEntry and TrustedIssuerEntry duplicate stoa_auth types
description: The refactor re-exported stoa_auth::UserCredential from reader config but left reader::config::ClientCertEntry and reader::config::TrustedIssuerEntry as separate local duplicates of the identical types in stoa_auth::config. This forces a manual struct-to-struct conversion shim in build_trusted_issuer_store (server_stores.rs:329-334) and a separate from_config on reader's local ClientCertStore (client_cert_store.rs:31) that takes the local type. Fix: re-export stoa_auth::ClientCertEntry and stoa_auth::TrustedIssuerEntry from reader config (same pattern as UserCredential), delete the local definitions, and remove the conversion in build_trusted_issuer_store.
